### **SEO_TITLE: Assam Assembly elections 2026: full schedule** **META_DESCRIPTION:** The Hindu | News | Politics | India In the bustling state of Assam, where politics often reflects the deep-seated concerns of history and modernity alike, the upcoming 2026 Assembly Elections promises to bring about significant changes. With over a decade since the last elections in 2013, the electorate eagerly awaits this historic event. The full schedule for Assam’s 2026 Assembly Elections has been unveiled, marking another year of political upheaval and change. The first phase will commence on March 5, followed by a second phase starting on May 4th. This phased approach is aimed at minimizing disruption to day-to-day life during the election period. The schedule includes over 100 constituencies spread across six districts. Key candidates and parties have already announced their manifestos, outlining their vision for governance in this crucial electoral season. Polling will be conducted through two phases, ensuring that voters are well-informed without any major disruptions to daily routines. As of now, the most notable changes from previous elections include a slight reduction in constituencies due to geographical considerations and an increased focus on digital campaigning. The election will likely see several key battlegrounds where incumbent parties have already been making their final appeals and securing local support. ### **FEATURED_IMAGE_PROMPT:** A striking image depicts scenes of vibrant campaign rallies, banners waving across town squares, and crowds of voters lining up to cast their ballots. The contrast between the lively atmosphere and serene landscapes surrounding Assam adds a unique visual appeal that encapsulates the spirit of this pivotal political event. ### **CONTENT_HTML**
